items.effect: Every time a die gets exhausted on the table, gain a random card.

items.name: Donut
items.effect: Every time you draw dice above your dice per turn (including rings), +5 extra value to every die in your hand.

items.name: Illusionist's Wand
items.effect: Every time you cycle through your whole bag, gain a random card.

items.name: Digital Mini-Watch
items.effect: Every 4 rolls, +8 extra value to every die on the table.

items.name: Solar Mini-Watch
items.effect: You should wear digital watch and analog watch at the same time. Every 7 rolls, temporarily get +3 hand size.

items.name: Hermit's Stone
items.effect: Halves the range of area effects. Rolls a copy of dice with area effects.

items.name: Hexagonal Ring
items.condition: Manually remove a Legendary die from your bag.
items.effect: At the start of every round gives a ghost legendary die.

items.name: Shiny Ring
items.condition: Get 6 stars during a boss round.
items.effect: +0.5 multiplier for each unspent stars at the end of a Boss round.

items.name: Hollow Ring
items.effect: Every roll adds 1 Hollow Die to your bag. Someone may want this...  Part of a quest. To obtain it, you need to win a round with no dice in your hand or bag. Take this ring and give it to the phone guy after defeating the Face 3 boss.

items.name: Wind Ring
items.effect: Choose a die. Moves other dice away from it. As far as I know, you can only get it from the console.

items.name: Extra roll
items.effect: +1 roll.

items.name: Choose face
items.effect: Choose a die and lock any face as its result this roll.

items.name: Draw
items.effect: Draw 5 dice from your bag.

items.name: Reroll
items.effect: Rerolls your hand or any item being chosen.

items.name: Enchant
items.effect: Adds a random enchantment to a die in your hand.

items.name: Clone
items.effect: Adds a ghost copy of a die in your hand. It will be destroyed after it's rolled.

items.name: Double Rings
items.effect: Next roll rings will activate an extra time.

items.name: Invert
items.effect: Next roll even numbers will count as odd and viceversa.

items.name: Power Up
items.effect: +8 extra value to every dice in your hand.

items.name: Multiply
items.effect: 2X Multiplier to every dice in your hand.

items.name: Transform
items.effect: Permanently transforms a die in your hand into another random one.

items.name: Auto reward
items.effect: Activate special rewards in the next round on the map without rolling the dice.

items.name: Charge
items.effect: +1 charge to every charged dice in your hand.

items.name: Resurrect
items.effect: Adds back to your bag the last die that was destroyed on the table.

items.name: Black Lotus
items.effect: +0.2 stamp multiplier to three random faces.

items.name: Love Card
items.effect: Every die has a 1 in 2 probability of coming back to hand after being rolled this turn.

items.name: Ace of Wands
items.effect: No die can be destroyed nor discarded on the table this turn.

items.name: Sealed Letter
items.effect: +0.4 stamp multiplier to your highest level face. (In case of draw, a random one is selected.)

items.name: White Card
items.effect: Permanently transforms all of your dice into other random ones. (Can only be used outside a round.)

items.name: Business Card
items.effect: Every die keeps its extra value at the end of this round.

items.name: Gift Card
items.effect: Choose and draw one die from your bag.

items.name: The Star
items.effect: +X extra value to a die. X being its highest face.

items.name: Burnt Card
items.effect: Every die on the table will be destroyed on the next roll.

items.name: Golden Ticket
items.effect: Randomly destroys one of your rings, then turns another one Gilded.

items.name: Shadow Glass
items.effect: Adds a permanent copy of a die in your hand. Gives both copies a random curse.

items.name: Ace of Stars
items.effect: +1star. (Can only be used in boss shops.)

items.name: Skip
items.effect: Skips the coming round, converts the next one into Red. You’re not able to get it even through the console.

items.name: White Hand
items.effect: Starts with a Reroll card.

items.name: Red Hand
items.effect: Few initial dice. Shops have a 25% discount.

items.name: Green Hand
items.condition: Have at least 25 dice in your bag as red.
items.effect: One less roll. You can roll 7 dice.

items.name: Purple Hand
items.condition: Have at least 5 enchanted dice in your bag.
items.effect: Extra card space. More likely to find enchanted dice.

items.name: Bicolor Hand
items.condition: Defeat The Even and The Odd bosses 5 times each.
items.effect: Maintain parity. Every roll must contain only odd dice or only even dice. If not, every die is discarded.

items.name: Blue Hand
items.condition: Beat Face 1 Boss without taking any rings.
items.effect: You can carry up to 12 rings. Start with a random common ring. More chance of rare rings.

items.name: Static Hand
items.effect: After the boss, donate stars in the shop until you see “something changes” above the Donate button. After that, a glitched spot will appear on the map (at the ring). Go there (25k pips required) and donate 1 Common, 1 Uncommon, 1 Rare, and 1 Legendary die. Embrace chaos. Start with 10 common rarity dice and other 5 of random rarities.

items.name: Yellow Hand
items.condition: Have a die reach 1000 extra value.
items.effect: Gain double extra value. Only 1 roll, buy more rolls at the shop.

items.name: Hollow Hand
items.condition: ??? You need to win a round with no dice in your hand or bag(you can do it at any round), then take the Hollow Ring and give it to the Phone Guy after the Face 3 boss. I completed this by removing all dice before the boss, leaving only Lucky Blocks, Diamond Die, the Equity Ring, two x2 cards, and the Choose card. With the Choose card, I set the diamond to 3. The Ring made the Lucky Blocks roll identical values, turning them into Diamonds, and the x2 cards provided an additional multiplier.
items.effect: Every die destroys itself when rolled. When dice are destroyed you gain shards, used for forging dice clones. Also, dice cannot be eternal. More rare and legendary dice.

items.name: Pale Hand
items.condition: Get all stamp multipliers to at least 1.5X.
items.effect: Lose all your pips when starting a new round. Gain stamp multipliers according to the amount of pips you had.

items.name: Black Hand
items.effect: Promote on power 6. Start with 5 random occult dice. Multiplies everything by your POWER level. +0.2 POWER when rolling occult dice, -0.1 every turn and for every occult die left in your hand.
